headings: The festival is held in Denpasar at the Werdhi Budaya Art Centre.
sections.markup:
[PHOTO]

The festival is held in Denpasar at the Werdhi Budaya Art Centre.

It lasts for a month and takes place every year from mid-June to the middle of July. It showcases the variety and richness of performing arts traditions from the different regions in Bali, as well as other provinces in Indonesia and a number of foreign countries.

On the opening day, an enormous parade of all the performing groups is held in Renon, Denpasar.

The festival is traditionally opened by the President of Indonesia.
